description: ChatGPT/Codex 5h and weekly usage via remote provider script.

parameters.name: CODEX_ACCESS_TOKEN
parameters.label: Codex access token
parameters.description: Optional override. By default the provider reads the local Codex auth file.

parameters.name: CODEX_ACCOUNT_ID
parameters.label: ChatGPT account id
parameters.description: Optional account id override when the local Codex auth file is not enough.

parameters.name: CODEX_AUTH_FILE
parameters.label: Codex auth file
parameters.description: Optional path to a Codex auth.json file.

parameters.name: QBWIN_PROXY_URL
parameters.label: Provider proxy URL
parameters.description: Optional runtime proxy for the Codex usage request. Prefer the provider Proxy URL setting; QuotaBarWin injects it as QBWIN_PROXY_URL.
